metadata.schemaStability: Stable field names and meanings. Changed in version 2: peachfileFilerEntityId and fecCandidateId became the lists peachfileFilerEntityIds / fecCandidateIds, because a person who files for two offices in one cycle has one filing per office; and a candidacies[] array was added. Records may carry vgId: null — see provenance.vgId for why.
metadata.scope: Georgia officeholders and 2026 ballot candidates: state legislators, statewide executives, the Georgia federal delegation, and every candidate on a race in races.json.
sources: Georgia Ethics Commission PeachFile — peachfileFilerEntityIds (derived, see provenance)

provenanceMethods.authoritative: the upstream source publishes this id for this person directly
provenanceMethods.reviewed: a human confirmed this match; recorded in an overrides file
provenanceMethods.curated: hand-entered in this repo's own data
provenanceMethods.seat+surname: derived by scripts/lib/ga_match.py — scoped to the seat, surname required
provenanceMethods.name-exact: exact match against the FEC candidate name index
provenanceMethods.district+surname: FEC candidates in the district, matched on surname
provenanceMethods.unkeyed: no durable upstream id exists for this person; vgId is null
provenanceMethods.out-of-scope: this identifier does not apply to this person

Filed under his legal name 'Jones, William B.' for Governor; committee 'Burt Jones for Georgia' confirms identity. Distinct from Vernon Jones (filer 100071, Secretary of State) — the reason this is pinned by hand rather than matched on surname.
Filed as 'Carr, Christopher M.' for Governor; committee 'Carr for Georgia, Inc.' Sole Carr filing for a statewide office.

Vacated House 68 to run for Governor (lost the 2026 primary); filed as 'Jackson, Derrick L.' for Governor, committee 'Committee to Elect Derrick Jackson', party DEM. His filing is under the Governor office he sought, not the House seat he held, so seat+surname could not match it.

Vacated Senate 14 to run for Lieutenant Governor (advanced through the 2026 primary runoff; on the November ballot); filed as 'McLaurin, Joshua' for Lieutenant Governor, committee 'Josh for Georgia, Inc.', party DEM. Filing is under the statewide office he sought, not the Senate seat he held, so seat+surname could not match it.

Won the 2026 Senate 7 Special Election and was sworn in June 26, 2026 (injected member, synthetic id — too new for Open States); not seeking re-election. Qualified with the SoS and filed in PeachFile under her name 'White, Adrienne' (SoS qualifying name Adrienne Annice White) for the Senate 7 Special Election, committee 'Adrienne for Georgia', party DEM. Surname on the filing (White) differs from her officeholder surname (Carden), so seat+surname could not match it.
